component.name: ChatGPT
component.summary: ChatGPT, Work and Codex desktop app

description.p: An unofficial Flatpak packaging of OpenAI's official ChatGPT desktop app for Linux, which upstream ships only as .deb and .rpm. The application binary is downloaded from OpenAI at install time and is not redistributed by this package.
This packaging exists for distributions upstream does not serve: Fedora atomic desktops (Silverblue, Bluefin, Bazzite, Aurora, Kinoite), openSUSE Aeon/MicroOS, Arch, NixOS, Alpine and Steam Deck.
It ships a sealed sandbox by default: no host filesystem access and no host command execution. Grant directories explicitly with flatpak override.
